# icon

```go
import "github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/component/icon"
```

Package icon is the set of marks that say what state something is in: done, failed, running, waiting. One set across an app, and across apps, so a check mark means the same thing in a list, a status line and plain CLI output.

<a name="Set"></a>
## type [Set](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/icon/icon.go#L28-L32>)

Set is one glyph per State, plus the marks lists, hints, steppers and trees lean on. Branch, LastBranch and Pipe are three cells each, the label's space included, so a child lines up under its parent's label.

```go
type Set struct {
    OK, Fail, Warn, Info, Pending, Running, Skipped string
    Bullet, Arrow, Line                             string
    Branch, LastBranch, Pipe                        string
}
```

```go
func ASCII() Set
```

ASCII is for terminals and logs that cannot show the Unicode set.

<a name="FromEnv"></a>
### func [FromEnv](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/icon/icon.go#L72>)

```go
func FromEnv() Set
```

FromEnv is ASCII when BEZEL\_ASCII is set or TERM is "dumb", Unicode otherwise, read only when called; animation.Still reads it too.

<a name="Set.Connector"></a>
### func \(Set\) [Connector](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/icon/icon.go#L54>)

```go
func (s Set) Connector(last bool) string
```

Connector is the prefix that hangs an item off its parent: a branch, or the closing one when the item is the last of its siblings.

<a name="Set.Indent"></a>

```go
func (s Set) Indent(last bool) string
```

Indent is what an item's children carry under its connector: the pipe while siblings follow it, blank once it was the last.
